public_payload.normalized_proposition: By the end of 2026, most AI services will move some or all customers to token-based billing.
conditions: some or all of their customers

statement.excerpt: I’m making the call that by the end of 2026, a majority of AI services will move some or all of their customers to token-based billing as they reckon with the true costs of running AI models.

from_speaker: move some or all of their customers
our_interpretation: A majority means more than half of services, counted equally rather than weighted by revenue or customers.
Move means an actual billing transition for existing customers after the post. An already available token-priced API does not establish a transition.
Credits qualify when their consumption is tied to tokens. Generic usage limits or request allowances do not automatically qualify.
The population is commercial generative AI services. Restricting it to a selected list of major providers would add a qualification the speaker did not supply.
The cost explanation is a proposed motivation, not an antecedent that must occur before the forecast applies.
criteria.support_condition: Dated billing records establish that more than half of a defensibly defined service population transitioned at least some existing customers to token-based billing between the post and December 31, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At the deadline, a sufficiently complete population count establishes that half or fewer made a qualifying transition.
